versions.changelog:
face-api 1.0.0 initial release:

- Enables face detection, landmark detection, recognition, emotion, and age/gender estimation using face-api.js with TensorFlow.js in browser or Node.js.
- Supports three face detectors (SSD Mobilenet v1, Tiny Face Detector, MTCNN) with guidance for model selection.
- Provides a unified, chainable API for detection, landmarks, descriptors, expressions, and age/gender.
- Allows drawing results (boxes, landmarks, expressions) to canvas and real-time webcam face tracking.
- Includes quick start instructions, core API usage, and notes on common setup gotchas.
